면접.ex: 내일 회사 면접이 있어서 조금 긴장돼요.
면접.x: I have a job interview tomorrow, so I'm a little nervous.
면접.t: The applicant says 면접을 보다 'take an interview'; the verb 하다 is used less.

존중.ex: 가족 사이에도 서로에 대한 존중이 중요해요.
존중.x: Mutual respect is important even within a family.

플라스틱.ex: 바다에 버려진 플라스틱이 큰 문제가 되고 있어요.
플라스틱.x: Plastic dumped in the ocean is becoming a big problem.
플라스틱.e: From English 'plastic'; Korean adds vowels, giving four syllables: peul-la-seu-tik.
플라스틱.t: A plastic bag is not 플라스틱 but 비닐봉지 — a Konglish surprise.

놀랍다.x: That person's memory is truly amazing.
놀랍다.e: Adjective made from 놀라다 'to be surprised', like 즐겁다 from 즐기다.
놀랍다.t: 놀라다 is how you feel ('I'm surprised'); 놀랍다 describes the thing that surprises you.

발명품.x: This museum has a lot of interesting inventions.
발명품.e: 발명 + -품 = item, product: 발명품, 작품, 제품.

귀중하다.ex: 호텔에서는 귀중한 물건을 프런트에 맡기는 게 좋아요.
귀중하다.x: At a hotel, it's best to leave valuable items at the front desk.

개방.x: This park is open to citizens even at night.

그렇지 않으면.forms: A. 그렇지 않으면 B. · casual: 안 그러면
그렇지 않으면.ex: 빨리 출발해요. 그렇지 않으면 길이 막혀요.
그렇지 않으면.x: Let's leave quickly. Otherwise we'll hit traffic.
그렇지 않으면.e: 그렇다 'to be so' + -지 않으면 'if not': 'if it isn't so'.
그렇지 않으면.t: Pronounced [그러치 아느면]. In casual speech people usually say 안 그러면: 서둘러, 안 그러면 늦어.

차장.m: deputy general manager (rank between 과장 and 부장)
차장.x: Deputy Manager Kim went on a business trip today.
차장.e: Literally 'next head' — the rank just below the 부장.
차장.t: Add 님 when you address or mention a superior: 차장님, not just 차장.

사망자.ex: 이번 사고로 사망자가 세 명 발생했습니다.
사망자.x: Three people died in this accident.
사망자.t: 사망 is formal news language; in conversation say 죽다, or honorific 돌아가시다 for elders.

집중력.ex: 잠을 충분히 못 자면 집중력이 떨어져요.
집중력.x: If you don't get enough sleep, your concentration drops.
집중력.e: Literally 'power to gather into the center'.

벌칙.m: penalty, penal rule; forfeit (in a game)
벌칙.ex: 게임에서 진 사람은 벌칙으로 노래를 불러야 해요.
벌칙.x: Whoever loses the game has to sing a song as a penalty.
벌칙.t: In daily life 벌칙 often means a fun penalty for losing a game, like singing or a forehead flick.

의욕.ex: 요즘 너무 피곤해서 아무것도 할 의욕이 없어요.
의욕.x: I'm so tired these days that I have no motivation to do anything.
의욕.t: 의욕이 없다 'to have no motivation' is a very common way to describe feeling burned out.

손상되다.m: to be damaged, to be harmed
손상되다.x: Important documents got damaged because they got wet in the rain.

채택하다.m: to adopt, to select (a proposal, method)
채택하다.x: The company eventually adopted his proposal.

타협하다.m: to compromise, to come to terms
타협하다.ex: 두 사람은 결국 서로 조금씩 양보하며 타협했어요.
타협하다.x: In the end, the two compromised by each giving in a little.
타협하다.t: Pronounced [타혀파다]; 타협하지 않다 often praises someone who sticks to principles.

뻗다.m: to stretch out (arms, legs); to extend, spread (roads, branches)
뻗다.x: I got up in the morning and stretched my arms out.
뻗다.t: Casually, 뻗다 also means to conk out from exhaustion or drinking.

쫓아가다.m: to chase after, run after, follow
쫓아가다.x: The police chased the fleeing thief all the way.
쫓아가다.t: 쫓다 is physical chasing; 좇다 is for pursuing goals, like 꿈을 좇다.

금강산도 식후경.m: eat first, then sightsee; nothing's fun on an empty stomach
금강산도 식후경.x: Nothing's fun on an empty stomach, so let's eat first.
금강산도 식후경.e: Literally 'even Mount Geumgang is a view for after the meal'.
nb: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다

파급 효과.ex: 올림픽은 지역 경제에 큰 파급 효과를 가져왔어요.
파급 효과.x: The Olympics had a big ripple effect on the local economy.
파급 효과.t: Pronounced [파그표과]: ㅂ and ㅎ merge into ㅍ.

사극.x: In historical dramas, the actors appear in hanbok.
사극.t: Most 사극 are set in the Joseon dynasty (조선), with palace scenes and old-style speech.

구독하다.m: to subscribe (to a channel, service, magazine)
구독하다.ex: 영상이 마음에 드시면 채널을 구독해 주세요.
구독하다.x: If you like the video, please subscribe to the channel.
구독하다.e: Literally 'buy to read' + 하다; first used for newspapers and magazines.
구독하다.t: Pronounced [구도카다]. Creators often end videos with 구독과 좋아요 부탁드려요 'please subscribe and like'. Also for paid services: 음악 앱을 구독하다. Cancel: 구독을 취소하다.

효력.m: effect, validity, force (of a law or contract)
효력.ex: 새 법은 다음 달부터 효력이 생깁니다.
효력.x: The new law takes effect starting next month.
효력.t: Use 효력 for legal force (계약의 효력) and 효과 for results (약의 효과).

조형물.x: A huge sculpture was put up in the middle of the square.

언급하다.ex: 대통령은 연설에서 경제 문제를 여러 번 언급했습니다.
언급하다.x: The president mentioned economic issues several times in his speech.
언급하다.e: Literally 'words reach' — your speech touches on a topic.
언급하다.t: Takes an object or 에 대해: 그 문제를 언급하다, 그 문제에 대해 언급하다.

밀집하다.m: to be crowded together, to be densely packed
밀집하다.x: The population is too densely packed in Seoul.
밀집하다.t: Pronounced [밀찌파다]; often 밀집되다 or 밀집해 있다.

부응하다.m: to meet, to live up to, to respond to (expectations, needs)
부응하다.ex: 그는 팬들의 기대에 부응하는 좋은 경기를 보여 줬어요.
부응하다.x: He played a great game that lived up to his fans' expectations.
부응하다.t: Almost always with 에: 기대에 부응하다, 요구에 부응하다.

악착같다.ex: 그는 악착같이 돈을 모아서 집을 샀어요.
악착같다.x: He saved money relentlessly and bought a house.
악착같다.e: 악착 'stubborn persistence' + 같다 'like'; the original meaning was 'petty, cramped'.
악착같다.t: The adverb 악착같이 is more common than the adjective: 악착같이 살다 'to live with fierce determination'.

워낙.m: so (very), just so; by nature, originally
워낙.ex: 그 친구는 워낙 성격이 좋아서 친구가 많아요.
워낙.x: She has such a great personality that she has lots of friends.
워낙.e: Its 'by nature' sense overlaps with 원래 'originally'.
워낙.t: Like 하도, it usually gives a reason: 워낙 ~아서 'because it's just so ~'.

계측.ex: 이 장비는 지진의 강도를 정확하게 계측합니다.
계측.x: This equipment accurately measures the strength of earthquakes.
계측.t: 계측 is technical and used for instruments; for everyday measuring, 재다 or 측정하다 is more common.

추상화.ex: 저는 추상화를 보면 무슨 뜻인지 잘 모르겠어요.
추상화.x: When I look at abstract paintings, I don't really get what they mean.
추상화.e: 추상 'abstract' + 화 'picture'; a homonym also means 'abstraction'.

치욕.ex: 그 패배는 우리 역사에 치욕으로 남았습니다.
치욕.x: That defeat remained a disgrace in our history.
치욕.t: The strongest of 수모, 굴욕 and 치욕; often used for national or historical shame.

시장실패.ex: 환경오염은 시장실패를 보여 주는 대표적인 예입니다.
시장실패.x: Pollution is a classic example of market failure.

지방자치단체.ex: 지방자치단체마다 청년을 위한 지원 정책이 달라요.
지방자치단체.x: Each local government has different support policies for young people.
지방자치단체.t: In everyday news it is almost always shortened to 지자체.

보상심리.m: compensatory mindset, urge to make up for something
보상심리.ex: 야근을 많이 한 날에는 보상심리로 쇼핑을 하게 돼요.
보상심리.x: On days I work late, I end up shopping to make up for it.
보상심리.t: Pronounced [보상심니] — ㄹ after ㅁ becomes ㄴ.

전자기학.ex: 전자기학은 전기와 자기의 관계를 연구하는 학문이에요.
전자기학.x: Electromagnetism is the study of the relationship between electricity and magnetism.
전자기학.e: Literally 'study of electric and magnetic energy'.

파동.x: Sound is a wave carried through the air.
파동.t: It's also used for economic shocks: 석유 파동 means 'the oil crisis'.

블록체인.ex: 블록체인 기술은 거래 기록을 안전하게 보관합니다.
블록체인.x: Blockchain technology stores transaction records securely.

순국선열.m: patriotic martyrs (who died for Korea's independence)
순국선열.ex: 우리는 순국선열의 희생을 절대 잊지 말아야 해요.
순국선열.x: We must never forget the sacrifice of the patriotic martyrs.
순국선열.e: Literally 'ardent forebears who died for the country'.
순국선열.t: 순국선열 died during the struggle; patriots who survived to liberation are called 애국지사.

기사회생.m: a narrow escape from death, a miraculous comeback
기사회생.ex: 우리 팀은 마지막 일 분에 골을 넣어 기사회생했어요.
기사회생.x: Our team scored in the last minute and made a miraculous comeback.
기사회생.e: Literally 'rise from death, return to life.'
기사회생.t: Common in sports and business news: 기사회생하다 means a team or company that seemed finished revived.

좌정관천.m: a narrow view of the world, like a frog in a well
좌정관천.ex: 좌정관천에서 벗어나려면 다양한 경험을 해 봐야 해요.
좌정관천.x: To escape a narrow view of the world, you need diverse experiences.
좌정관천.e: Literally 'sitting in a well, looking at the sky'.
좌정관천.t: The everyday equivalent is 우물 안 개구리 'a frog in a well'.

자각하다.m: to become aware of, to realize (about oneself)
자각하다.x: He belatedly realized his own mistake.
자각하다.t: 자각 증상 means symptoms the patient can notice, e.g. 자각 증상이 없다 'no noticeable symptoms'.

아득하다.m: far off, distant, faint; at a loss
아득하다.x: The summit still looked far, far away.
아득하다.e: Also 눈앞이 아득하다 'to feel faint, at a loss' — distance turned into a feeling.
아득하다.t: Also for time and memory: 아득한 옛날 'long, long ago'. Pronounced [아드카다].

포악하다.ex: 동화 속 포악한 거인이 마을 사람들을 괴롭혔어요.
포악하다.x: In the fairy tale, a brutal giant tormented the villagers.
포악하다.t: The first syllable is read 포 here, but the same character is read 폭 in 폭력 (violence).

궤적.m: trajectory, track, path (of a life or career)
궤적.ex: 이 책은 한 예술가의 삶의 궤적을 따라가요.
궤적.x: This book follows the trajectory of an artist's life.

자본잠식.ex: 계속된 적자로 회사가 자본잠식 상태에 빠졌습니다.
자본잠식.x: Continued losses put the company into a state of capital erosion.
자본잠식.e: Literally 'capital eaten by silkworms': losses nibble away the equity bit by bit.
